_doc: EC2 GPU worker config for the avatar (数字人) module: one image serves InfiniteTalk and LongCat-Video-Avatar-1.5 (request field model). server/app/gpu_ec2.py reads it. The adapter copies the requested model's weights from the pinned prefixes in weights_index to NVMe on first use; bootstrap copies only the small index (weights). Capacity order from the measurements in docs/AVATAR.md.
name: evp-avatar-worker
_capacity_note: g7e.2xlarge (64 GB host RAM) is NOT listed: InfiniteTalk's loader merges the ~66 GB fp32 Wan2.1 DiT shards in CPU memory and the container was OOM-killed there (2026-11-04). g6e (48 GB GPU) would need CPU offload; not measured.
render_note: 480_fast for both models measured warm on g7e.4xlarge 2026-11-04; other cells estimated (docs/AVATAR.md). longcat fast/full are the same path (8-step distill is required).
usd_per_hour_note: first capacity option = g7e.4xlarge Spot us-east-1a (spot history 2026-11-04); on-demand fallback higher
